local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local t=-1
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during actual Charm casting')
 local bandit=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x4bb63))
 if not bandit or not bandit:isValid() then return end
 local origin=self.position+util.vector3(0,0,65)
 local target=bandit.position+util.vector3(0,0,50)
 local dv=target-origin;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*dv.x-f.x*dv.y,f.x*dv.x+f.y*dv.y)
 local pitch=-math.atan2(dv.z,math.sqrt(dv.x*dv.x+dv.y*dv.y))
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue voice target aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*256+.5)))))
 print('VilverinContinue voice target ready health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' banditHealth='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(bandit).current..' distance='..dv:length())
end}}}}
